# PRD-REL-03

**Has a load test exercised the high-importance performance and reliability scenarios at the expected peak?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [Production entry lens](production.md) 0.1.1 |
| Area | REL: Release and recovery |
| Default severity | major |
| Decided by | A tool checks presence; a reviewer judges |
| Reads | `scenarios`, `evidence.type`, `evidence.covers` |

## Rule

evidence has a load-test for this version whose covers includes every quality scenario with importance high and quality_attribute performance-efficiency or reliability. A reviewer checks the load matched the stated peak.
